title: Text: DET Mikaela Higgins ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey it's Anthony, save my number
Mikaela Higgins just so you know how to spell it
I'm a two-time spelling bee runner-up, c'mon now
I think we're going to go a little bit earlier than normal, like 5:30-6, if you wanna come
Hey thanks! I am still working, but next time if that's cool? I really appreciate you inviting me and would like to hangout soon
No problem. I don't think we're even going any more, I'm just going to go to Panera later
